decisionAndEvidence.recommended: Feed one exact held file range through bounded stdin, with explicit matroska or mov demuxer and pipe as the only permitted protocol. A standalone approved fixture is merely the start0/end=fileLength case. This avoids a new raw copy, a future fixed-file-only redesign, and handing a whole repeated-init spool to a demuxer.
decisionAndEvidence.alternatives: A guarded whole-file path is simpler but does not isolate units in the eventual append spool. Copying each unit would add disk/lifetime/cleanup obligations; concat/subfile/cache/fd inputs would add seeking, address or protocol authority. None is a fallback in this batch. Pipe adds one bounded producer worker and exact completion accounting; actual nonseekable fragmented MOV and WebM compatibility must be tested rather than assumed.
decisionAndEvidence.parentChangeRequiringApproval: The parent initially described fixed owned local tool inputs. This proposal refines only their transport to native-read, exact-range pipe input. It does not authorize a browser path, arbitrary file, network, repeated-init concatenation, independent timestamp origin or new derived media. Root must explicitly ratify this refinement before code.
decisionAndEvidence.actualBasis: The immutable raw pair0ab34128-d5cf-43b2-8fad-2d2fe9cc89c2 contains one124392-byte VP9 WebM unit and one82189-byte AAC MP4 unit. Independent file-based probes found150/216 packets. The AAC structure includes harmless skip[632,968) between moov and moof; this is not a reason to rewrite it. The common-origin candidate preserved ordered payloads and passed separate decode/native tests. Its wrong-origin predecessor retained the same counts/payloads but added skip_samples651. None of those file-based results proves pipe equivalence.
decisionAndEvidence.costQualification: Per-unit child startup and repeated prefix inspection may be expensive over many hours. This batch proves a bounded one-unit primitive, not a high-throughput scheduler. A later caller may reuse one still-held verified inspection under separately reviewed ownership.

inputCapability.origin: Use the approved internal inspect_and_index flow, not caller-created/mutable CommittedPrefix, Unit, path, format or length. A private non-serializable UnitSpan borrows the still-held inspection context and the selected native indexed unit after its required terminal index outcome and final source guards have succeeded. Preserve full SpoolIdentity, track, ordinal, exact raw start/initEnd/end, configuration/init hashes, source clock and all inherited interruption flags. The handoff and borrow API must be agreed with the wrapper owner before implementation; no duplicate journal/proof reader.
inputCapability.validation: Reject Corrupt/Cancelled inspection, absent/failed/partial required index outcome, foreign owner/source/document/epoch, mismatched track/format/configuration and any range not satisfying0<=start<initEnd<end<=verified committed track length<=held physical length. Initial scope admits a complete indexed unit only, not a guessed prefix of PartialTail. Interrupted-but-structurally-complete inspection remains explicitly Interrupted; probing it does not authorize recovery/publication. No active writer may retain a conflicting write handle.
inputCapability.guards: Reuse files::GuardedFile and Directories with exact physical lengths of both raw files, proof and journal retained by the approved wrapper. Keep handles held throughout preprocessing, child execution, worker joins and postchecks. On Windows they deny write/delete sharing; do not claim that protection on unsupported hosts. Recheck identity/non-reparse/single-link/directory/length and cancellation before work, at process admission, during the watchdog and after all workers complete. Do not use storage::regular followed by an unrelated File::open as a lifetime capability.
inputCapability.range: Seek the same held raw handle to start and read exactly end-start bytes, at most128KiB at a time. Never read an uncommitted tail, a neighboring init, another track or a path obtained from the media. Compute a SHA256 of the exact range before transfer, then hash the exact bytes sent to the pipe and require equality. Postcheck the same guarded range/hash and original physical lengths; no unchecked path reopen. Retain only hashes/counters, never the complete unit.
inputCapability.testsOnly: An explicitly cfg(test) constructor may use authored guarded fixtures or the already approved immutable standalone raw-pair files with recorded hashes. It must be absent from production and cannot manufacture proof/journal files in the evidence directory. No test helper grants a production caller a free-form path capability.

containedLifecycle.reuse: process::stream_lines is chat-specific:8KiB stdin, line normalization that strips required LF/CRLF, chat errors and a stderr drain that does not preserve read failures. process::run collects output. containedLifecycle.spawn: One child at a time, no background queue or detached retry. Build Command directly, CREATE_NO_WINDOW|CREATE_SUSPENDED on Windows, assign the existing kill-on-close JobObject with512MiB process-memory ceiling, then resume. Failure at spawn/containment/pipe extraction/thread creation kills and waits for the owned child tree. Do not start outside containment and attach later. Other platforms remain unsupported until equivalent containment is separately approved.
containedLifecycle.workers: Use three bounded scoped workers: held-range stdin producer, raw stdout reader feeding Decoder synchronously, and stderr drain. No unbounded channels, packet collection or read_to_end. The stdin worker handles short reads/writes, counts bytes actually written, closes stdin only after the complete range or failure, and reports BrokenPipe/earlyEOF as failure even if the child exits0. Stdout chunks retain exact newline bytes. Stderr is counted/drained independently with a64KiB total cap, no saved raw text; read error, overflow or nonempty -v error output fails the evidence.
containedLifecycle.watchdog: Native monotonic120-second wall deadline per unit, starting before range preprocessing and checked between bounded reads, before spawn, each at-most100ms child poll and after joins/postchecks. Childmemory512MiB; input range no greater than the existing128GiB committed bound; output limits remain packet_facts20M rows/4GiB text/2048-byte row/32MiB packet. These are ceilings, not a promise that a128GiB unit finishes in120 seconds. Timeout preserves sources; there is no automatic cap increase, restart, arbitrary splitting or fallback. Smaller limits may be injected only in tests.
containedLifecycle.failure: Latch the first fixed failure, revoke provisional output, terminate the JobObject before joining workers, including after direct-parent exit so descendants cannot retain pipes. Scope/RAII must also cover panic, failed worker spawn and inspection failure. Killing an unrelated Atsumi/browser/system process is forbidden. Check cancellation before every read/write or decoder chunk and at final return. Synchronous local disk calls are not guaranteed interruptible by a strict wall deadline; keep eventual use off the UI thread and state that limitation rather than detaching blocked borrowed workers.
containedLifecycle.successConjunction: Only exact stdin byte count and expected input hash, stdin closed, physical stdout EOF, Decoder.finish success, TrackFold.finish success, stderr EOF with no errors/output, child exit0, all workers joined, unchanged guarded files/tool and final uncancelled/deadline check may return evidence. A complete last line without stdout EOF, a fold without child success, or child exit0 after partial input is not success. Cancellation after apparent exit but before final return still rejects.
